text: The Fundación Vicky Foods is the foundation through which the Vicky Foods group manages its social action.
short: Fundación Vicky Foods is the social-action foundation of the Vicky Foods group.

source.name: Vicky Foods: 'Vicky Foods adquiere Panrico y refuerza su liderazgo en el mercado del pan en Iberia'
